send_when: Withheld pages/tabs appear central to selection value or source-note fields
include: Original request ID, release date, file unit, page/tab numbers, exemptions, and why the withheld material is needed for organization/management history

send_when: Withdrawal metadata names minutes, summary, decision paper, attachment, legislative language, Gates briefing, or legal memo
include: Withdrawal-sheet count, document titles/dates, exemptions, file unit, OA/ID or other repository control identifier, any NAID locator, and selected pages/tabs for re-review

send_when: Referral agency, date, or tracking number is known but no substantive response has arrived
include: Referring office, receiving agency, referral date, original and new tracking numbers, file unit, and requested status update

send_when: Response searched only one office, series, date range, or keyword set
include: Exact search scope from response, missing likely offices/series, alternate names, dates, OA/IDs, NAIDs, and public/source anchors

follow_up_route: Fallback confirmation or alternate repository check
send_when: Search appears broad enough to support fallback or drop, but fallback decision needs evidence
include: Search scope, repositories searched, public fallback text, and request for confirmation that no archival control copy was located

send_when: Response names a better folder, OA/ID, lot file, box, series, or NAID locator
include: Parent request ID, new repository control identifiers, any public locator identifiers, relationship to original target, and exact scan/MDR/folder pull ask

send_when: Two packets overlap and one may be fuller or cleaner for source-note control
include: Both file units, page counts, release differences, duplicate tabs, variant tabs, and request for missing pages or clearer control source

trigger: Released copy but source-note fields missing
send_when: A scan is usable but does not show folder title, classification, routing, attachments, or version status
include: File name, page count, suspected source, missing FRUS fields, and request for repository/source-note metadata

send_when: Public text exists, but final source-note standard requires a documented archival search
include: Public citation, suspected archival offices/series, requested search scope, and fallback decision need

send_when: A response supplies a public file unit, PDF, catalog record, or publication link
include: URL, page title, date accessed, response context, and source-note role: locator, control copy, fallback, or support
